description: Terminal-Bench style database task: enforce the events retention contract (at most 10000 rows, the newest by id) inside data/events.db with an INSERT trigger and a prune_events() routine, plus a reproducible migrate.py. The gate recomputes everything by inserting 20000 rows and checking the other tables. Only python3 is assumed (no sqlite3 CLI).

criteria: The events table is capped at 10000 newest rows by a database trigger and prune_events(), the reference tables, their rows and the documented indexes are untouched, and migrate.py reproduces the migration.
